  opts_chunk:

---

```{r}
#| label: pkgs
#| include: false

use("nemo", "nemo_uml")
use("tidydragen", "DRAGEN_TOOLS")
use("purrr", "map_chr")
use("knitr", "asis_output")
```

```{r}
#| label: uml

x <- sort(c(
  map_chr(DRAGEN_TOOLS, "classname"),
  "Config",
  "Tool",
  "DragenTool",
  "Dragen",
  "Workflow"
))
# hand it over directly to knitr for rendering, cat somehow doesn't work any more
asis_output(nemo_uml(
  classes = x,
  pkg = "tidydragen"
))
```
